 Kayem recalls 1.58 million pounds of meat and poultry over temperature concerns
 Jonathan Lundy , Digital Producer , Jacksonville 
 Published:  October 20, 2026 at 10:22 AM Tags:  Food Recall , Consumer , Money Kayem Foods recall meat and poultry products. FLORIDA – Kayem Foods is recalling about 1.58 million pounds of ready-to-eat meat and poultry products that may have been stored at unsafe temperatures, the U.S. Department of Agriculture’s Food Safety and Inspection Service announced.
 The products were made from March 31 through Oct. 7 and shipped to retail and food-service locations nationwide and in Hong Kong. They bear establishment numbers “EST. M/P 7839,” “EST. P 20935A” or “EST. M 9520” inside the USDA inspection mark. Consumers can check the FSIS recall notice for product names, labels and UPC codes.
 Recommended Videos
 The company began investigating after a retail customer reported warm products at delivery on Oct. 1. Kayem found that a warehouse cooler had experienced temperature deviations.
 No illnesses have been confirmed. Consumers who have the recalled products should not eat them; they should throw them away or return them to the place of purchase. Anyone concerned about an illness should contact a health care provider.
 Consumers can contact Kayem customer service at 800-426-6100 or info@kayem.com , Monday through Friday, from 7:30 a.m. to 4 p.m. EDT.
